notes.title: Duskborn Patch 0.2.1
notes.notes:
[h2]New Features[/h2]

[list]
[*]  New effect [b]Ground Bombardment[/b] can now drop from [b]AJAX Dragonfly[/b]
[*] [b]AJAX cutting prism[/b] effect will now automatically switch targets when the current target is dead
[*] Boss enemies can now drop loot orbs, that can be collected by the player to obtain their attacks
[*] [b]Squidling seekers[/b] now predict the direction of their target, making them more difficult to dodge
[*] the duration of buff effects now also scales with the effectiveness of the trigger they are associated with.
[/list]

[h2]Balancing[/h2]

[list]
[*] nerfed [b]OnCriticalStrike[/b] trigger
[*] health of stationary enemies (Angels, Annihilators and Bosses) now scales stronger with current depth, making them tankier when looping.
[*] tuned down strength of player [b]dash[/b]
[*] [b]Hydraulic Overload[/b] now also buffs jetpack refuel rate
[*] removed [b]Winch Enhancer[/b] buff
[*] [b]Exoskeleton Overdrive[/b] now also buffs grappling speed
[*] utility buffs now last longer
[/list]
